id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

checked.description: Whether the toggle should be checked by default.

disabled.description: If true, displays the input at a lower opacity, with a non-interactable input.

readonly.description: If true, will make the input unselectable but at full (normal) opacity.

indeterminate.description:
Only a checkbox inputType may be 'indeterminate'. Instead of a checkmark, the symbol inside the checkbox will be a dash '-'.
Indeterminate checkboxes are displayed in a state which is distinct both from being checked or being unchecked. They are commonly used in hierarchical checkboxes to indicate that only some of the checkbox's descendants are checked.

emphasized.description:
If true, the color of the ::after pseudo element will be blue. Otherwise it will be white.
For inputType: 'radio', the change in color will occur in the dot that fills in a checked radio input.
For inputType: 'checkbox', the change in color will be applied to it's background color.
For inputType: 'toggle', the change in color will be applied to the background color of the toggle itself not the handle.

showLabel.description: Whether or not text should be displayed on the right side of the toggle/checkbox/radio.
